mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_knowledge_index_status (project_type, project_id, source_ref, content_hash, index_status, chunk_count, last_error) VALUES (#{projectType}, #{projectId}, #{sourceRef}, #{contentHash}, 'PENDING', 0, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_ref = VALUES(source_ref), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), index_status = 'PENDING', chunk_count = 0, last_error = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE project_knowledge_index_status SET index_status = 'INDEXING', last_error = NULL WHERE project_type = #{projectType} AND project_id = #{projectId}

UPDATE project_knowledge_index_status SET knowledge_document_id = #{documentId}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, index_status = 'DONE', chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, last_error = NULL, last_indexed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_type = #{projectType} AND project_id = #{projectId}
UPDATE project_knowledge_index_status SET index_status = 'FAILED', last_error = #{error} WHERE project_type = #{projectType} AND project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_type, project_id, source_ref, knowledge_document_id, content_hash, index_status, chunk_count, last_error, last_indexed_at, create_time, update_time FROM project_knowledge_index_status ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
